hypothesis: A global symmetric interval with a training-calibrated additive floor can raise E005 SPS above persistence while leaving point predictions and deterministic quality unchanged.

interval.selection: maximum calibration SPS; deterministic candidate-list order breaks exact ties

final_evaluation.source: saved E005 E002-validation point predictions; no new model inference

controls: E005 checkpoint and point-prediction implementation are frozen
candidate grid and selection rule are fixed before training residual inference
calibration uses only the explicit 64 E002-training trajectories
the selected candidate is audited without using audit results for selection
E002 validation targets are used once after interval selection

preflight.reason_for_grid_expansion: A two-trajectory training-side smoke selected the original beta=0.15 upper boundary. The beta grid was expanded through 0.30 before the full calibration run or any E002-validation bound evaluation.

limitations: The E005 model was trained on both calibration and audit trajectories, so their residuals can be optimistic even though interval selection is separated.
The single E002 split has already accumulated substantial model-selection pressure.
Local RTX 5050 timing is not directly comparable with Codabench A800 timing.
